title: Satantango

vibeProfile.oneLine: A ruined village waits for salvation, and a swindler answers.

summary: On a collapsing collective farm in rain-soaked rural Hungary, a set of ruined, scheming villagers wait for money and deliverance, and then for the return of the charismatic con man Irimias, who may be a saviour or a swindler. Krasznahorkai tells it in vast, coiling, almost unbroken sentences that mimic the mud and stupor of the place, building a hypnotic, apocalyptic vision of hope curdling into manipulation. Demanding and unforgettable, it is one of the towering works of late twentieth-century European fiction.
whyReadIt: A hypnotic, mud-soaked masterpiece for readers who want to be swallowed whole. Surrender to the long sentences and it becomes unforgettable.

funFacts.text: Bela Tarr filmed it as a seven-hour black-and-white epic that is itself a landmark of world cinema.
